_about: Rules from docs/game_bible.md, kept as config for scripts/validate.js. Only Gabriella edits the bible; update this file to match whenever the bible changes. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_budget_note: Maya's budget is $ in chapters 1-3. From chapter 4 it is $$: her promotion covers the trip (bible: Cast + Story beats). budget_max_by_chapter overrides budget_max for the chapters it lists.
_characters_note: Brooke's 'health conscious, not greasy' is mapped to the soft vibe 'healthy'. The bible does not spell out this mapping. Remove it if that is wrong.

dietary_tags._note: What a venue must carry in dietary_tags to safely serve each constraint. The bible names peanut_free and vegan_options; the others follow the same pattern. A vegan kitchen also covers vegetarians.

_chapters_note: max_hard counts allergies + diets. Maya's budget is not counted, which matches level_01's outline row. The bible says only that later chapters 'can run longer', so the 30-message cap for chapters 3-4 is a proposed value.

night_market._imports_note: Bible: only favourites from earlier chapters (campus, downtown). Cross-level, so Integration enforces it.

satay_incident.title: The Satay Incident
satay_incident.page: One plate of satay, one peanut allergy, one lunch the crew still won't joke about. Never again.

trip_fund.title: The Trip Fund
trip_fund.page: Every dollar Maya doesn't spend is a dollar closer to the coast. Cheap eats only: the fund is sacred.

page_from_chapter.4: From chapter 4: "did the math, trip is funded."

plate_of_fries.title: The Plate of Fries
plate_of_fries.page: Burger night: everyone had a double stack, and Mina quietly ate a plate of fries. Liam still isn't over it.

milkshake_incident.title: The Milkshake Incident
milkshake_incident.page: Roxy ordered the biggest milkshake on the menu. Her stomach did not agree. Dairy and Roxy are not friends.

sushi_day.title: Sushi Day
sushi_day.page: Cyrus found a whole section with zero meat, and Mina ordered whatever looked good without asking about any of it. Best lunch of her summer.

_callbacks_note: Bible: Campaign structure > Callbacks and Scrapbook. Dialogue lines may carry "callback": "<id>". The Validator (check 11) uses friend and first_level; the game reads title, page, page_from_chapter and art for the Scrapbook (page_from_chapter adds a line once the player has reached that chapter).
_callback_first_appearance_note: When true, check 11 fails a level that is a callback's first_level but has no line tagged with it. False until levels 01-10 are retrofitted (branch retrofit/callbacks); until then it is reported as WARN.

crew._allow_human_note: level_01 was written by hand (generated_by: human:gabby). Set this to false to require a crew id in generated_by.
